title: Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields with Bidirectional Diffusion Encoders for Zero-Training Cross-Ontology Medical Coding
abstract: arXiv:2611.30218v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Healthcare systems continually revise clinical taxonomies, update reimbursement schedules, and harmonize cross-border registries. Existing automated coding models bind clinical text understanding to fixed vocabulary-specific heads, requiring manual relabeling and retraining whenever code sets change. We introduce Ontology-Compiled 2D Clinical State Fields (OCSF), a vocabulary-free framework that decouples clinical document reading from target ontology indexing so one trained encoder can switch across arbitrary medical vocabularies in seconds without target training. A single-pass bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and vocabulary-free decoder map each clinical note into a fixed-dimension two-dimensional state matrix with zero code-specific parameters. translated_title: 基于本体编译二维临床状态场与双向扩散编码器的零训练跨本体医学编码
translated_abstract: 医疗系统不断修订临床分类体系、更新报销计划并协调跨国登记系统。现有的自动化编码模型将临床文本理解绑定到固定的词表专用输出头上，每当编码集合发生变更时都需要人工重新标注和重新训练。我们提出了本体编译二维临床状态场，这是一个无词表框架，它将临床文档阅读与目标本体索引解耦，使得一个训练好的编码器可以在数秒内切换到任意医学词表，而无需针对目标词表进行训练。单次前向传播的双向扩散预训练编码器与无词表解码器将每份临床病历映射为固定维度的二维状态矩阵，不包含任何编码特定参数。任意目标本体都可以通过公开的文本描述在CPU上离线编译为一个尺度不变的Tikhonov反卷积算子，该算子在压制同级编码干扰的同时……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出无词表框架OCSF，通过将临床文档编码为固定维度的二维状态矩阵，并利用离线编译的Tikhonov反卷积算子匹配任意目标本体，实现了无需重新训练、数秒内即可切换医学编码词表的零训练跨本体医学编码。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OCSF, a vocabulary-free framework that maps clinical notes into fixed-dimension 2D state matrices via a bidirectional diffusion-pretrained encoder and matches them to any target ontology through offline-compiled Tikhonov deconvolution operators, enabling zero-training cross-ontology medical coding with vocabulary switching in seconds.
